# Browser runtime packages

These wheels come from the official Pyodide 0.27.7 `full` distribution. They
are copied into the built site and loaded from the product's own origin.

- Pyodide: MPL-2.0
- DuckDB: MIT
- Apache Arrow / PyArrow: Apache-2.0
- NumPy and pandas: BSD-3-Clause
- python-dateutil: Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause
- pytz: MIT
- six: MIT
- pyodide-unix-timezones: MPL-2.0

Source index: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/pyodide-lock.json`
The lock file records SHA-256 hashes for every copied wheel.
